title: Functional French-Advanced Beginner
prerequisites_raw: FSL105H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department's Placement Test.  Before enrolling in a French language course for the first time all students MUST complete the Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ ).
exclusions_raw: FSL102H1 . Grade 11 and Grade 12 Core French and all grade levels in French Immersion, Extended French, and French Secondary Schools.
